title: rinx entity schema
description: A project's entity meta-model, as the schema file spells it.

entity_type.description: The entity types this project declares, one `[[entity_type]]` each.

import_keys.description:
Names a `.. needimport::` may write instead of a path, each mapped to
the file it stands for — sphinx-needs' `needs_import_keys`.

A path, unlike the `template` an entity type names: the alias is
written in a *document*, so its meaning belongs with the project's
vocabulary rather than in the build file. The file it names must still
be declared in the library's `parse_data`, since only the build system
can put it in the parse action's sandbox.

role.description:
Inline roles that reference an entity from prose. Optional: every entity
is reachable by `:ref:` and by the built-in `:entity:` role regardless.

RawArgument.description: How `.. <type>:: <argument>` maps onto the type's attributes.

fields.description:
Attribute names, in the order the argument's parts fill them. Each must
be an attribute the type declares.

split.description: How the argument text is divided before being mapped.

default.description: The value used when the option is absent.

label.description: Human-readable label for the rendered field table.

pattern.description:
A regular expression the value must match; for `list<string>`, each
item must. Searched for, as JSON Schema's `pattern` is: write `^…$` to
match the whole value. Only the three text types take one.

required.description: Whether the option must be given.

values.description:
The permitted values. Required for the two enum types, and refused for
every other — both spellings look like they constrain the value, and
only one does.

RawAttributeType.description:
The `type = "..."` spellings an attribute may declare.

A typed enum rather than a free string, so an unknown spelling is refused
by deserialization — which both shortens the loader and lets the generated
JSON Schema offer the seven valid values as completions.

RawEntityType.description: One entity type: a directive name plus everything an instance may carry.

argument.description:
How the text after `::` maps onto attributes. Omit for a type that
takes no argument.

attribute.description: Typed values, never parsed as RST.

id.description: How instances of this type are identified.

label.description: Human-readable label for the built-in rendering; defaults to `name`.

name.description: The directive name, e.g. `req` for `.. req::`.

relation.description: Typed edges to other entities, declared on the type that carries them.

section.description: Named prose sections, whose content *is* fully-parsed RST.

template.description:
A `MiniJinja` template's file name, supplied by the site's
`entity_templates` attribute. Omit for the built-in rendering.

RawId.description: How an entity type's ids are determined.

from.description:
Attributes whose values compose the id, joined with `_`. Each must be an
attribute the type declares.

pattern.description:
A regular expression every id of this type should match — explicit,
composed or generated, prefix included. Searched for, as JSON Schema's
`pattern` is: write `^…$` to match the whole id. A mismatch is reported
as `entity.id-pattern-mismatch`, and the entity keeps its id.

prefix.description: Prepended to derived and generated ids, never to an explicit `:id:`.

required.description: Whether the author must write an explicit `:id:`.

RawRelation.description: A typed edge to other entities, declared on the type that carries it.

incoming.description:
The back-link name derived on each target. Omit for a one-directional
relation.

incoming_label.description: Heading for that back-link; defaults to `incoming`.

label.description: Label shown by the built-in rendering; defaults to `name`.

multiple.description: Whether more than one target id may be named.

name.description: The option spelling on the source entity, e.g. `links` for `:links:`.

required.description: Whether at least one target id must be named.

to.description: Entity types a target may have. Omit to accept any type.

RawRole.description: An inline role that references an entity from prose.

types.description: Entity types the role may resolve to. Omit to accept any type.

RawSection.description: A named prose section, written as a sub-directive inside an entity's body.

label.description: Heading shown by the built-in rendering; defaults to `name`.

multiple.description: Whether it may appear more than once, kept in document order.

name.description: The sub-directive name. May not shadow a directive the build already has.

required.description: Whether the sub-directive must appear at least once.

RawSplit.description: How a directive's argument text is divided.

oneOf.description: The whole argument is one value — the sphinx-needs shape.
